title: Spyro origin
description: Adds Spyro the dragon from the Legend of Spyro games as a playable origin into Minecraft
body:
![Spyro Origin](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e89cce43e24fafa9d54a20cf184a4a2252b38a2b.png)

Adds Spyro the dragon based on the Legend of Spyro games as a playable origin into Minecraft!

Inspired by Spyro the Dragon and The legend of Spyro series!

**Mods Required:**
- [Origins](https://modrinth.com/mod/origins)
- [Pehkui](https://modrinth.com/mod/pehkui)

**I do NOT own the rights to Spyro or anything related to the Spyro franchise. All rights are owned by Microsoft.**

# Spyro Origin
A rare and special breed of dragon. Prophecies spoken among the Dragons foretell that Purple Dragons are said to be born once every ten generations and harness the power of all elements (Fire, Ice, Earth, and Electricity).

## 💪Powers💪

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

### 🔥⚡🧊🪨Element Switch🔥⚡🧊🪨
- As a purple dragon, you have the ability to switch between the four elements (Fire, Ice, Earth, and Electricity) by sneaking and pressing the LoadToolbarActivator active key. Each element grants you different abilities and effects, but you can only have one element active at a time.
- The order is Fire, Electricity, Ice, Earth. Pressing the LoadToolbarActivator active key while sneaking will switch to the previous element.

### 🟣Aether🟣
- By harnessing the power of all 4 elements, you are able to harness the energy of the universe, the Aether, and use it to unleash powerful attacks. While in this special state, you will deal extra damage and have access to special abilities, but it will replace your elemental powers for a short time
- You must fill the fury meter to the max to use this ability by killing enemies.
- While in this state, you only 60 seconds to use Aether's abilities before the power runs out.

- **Powers while in Aether**
  - Aether Beam
    - [Primary] Harness the power of the aether to shoot a powerful beam of energy that damages anyone in its path, piercing through armor and shields.
    - You can hold down the key to continuously fire this beam. Additionally, this beam has no cooldown and deals true half a heart of damage per hit.
  - Aether Dash
    - [Secondary] By infusing Aether with your Comet dash, you are able to make it more powerful while also granting you 2 extra dashes that regenerate over time after use
  - Fury Attack
    - Your attacks are amplified by the power of Aether. You deal 50% increased damage while in Aether.

### 🔥⚡🧊🪨All elements🔥⚡🧊🪨

- **🔥Fire🔥**
  - Fire breath
    - [Primary while NOT sneaking] You are able to breath a large amount of fire in front of you, damaging and setting on fire any entity caught in the flames.
    - You must be using the Fire element to use this ability.
    - This is also capable of breaking leaves and grass
  - Fireball
    - [Primary while sneaking] You can shoot out a fireball that deals increased damage and does not explode.
    - You must be using the Fire element to use this ability.
  - Comet Dash
    - [Secondary] You can dash forward, damaging any enemies in your path. Any damage dealt will be also burnt and set the target on fire.
    - You must be using the Fire element to use this ability.
- **⚡Electricity⚡**
  - Lightning Bolt
    - [Primary] You are able to shoot a beam of electricity that electrocutes the target hit.
    - You must be using the Electricity element to use this ability.
    - Electrocution causes the target to take lightning based damage over time and be disarmed for 5 seconds, preventing them from being able to deal any damage.
  - Electric sphere
    - [Secondary] You are able to cover yourself in a sphere of electricity before discharging that energy, electrocuting and damaging any nearby enemies. 
    - You must be using the Electricity element to use this ability.
    - Electrocution causes the target to take lightning based damage over time and be disarmed for 5 seconds, preventing them from being able to deal any damage.
- **🧊Ice🧊**
  - Ice Stream Breath
    - [Primary while holding] You are able to breath a continuous stream of ice in front of you, damaging and freezing any entity caught in the stream, as well as freezing water blocks into frosted ice. Enemies caught in the stream will be slowed and take freeze damage, which is a special type of damage that bypasses armor and can eventually freeze the target if they take too much of it.
    - You must be using the Ice element to use this ability.
    - This ability does not have a cooldown but a meter that charges up over time when not using the ability. Shares the same meter with Snowstorm
  - Snowstorm
    - [Secondary while holding] Summon a mini-tornado that sucks in anyone in a radius of 7 blocks and swirls them around and raises them off the ground at where you are by sneaking and holding secondary.
    - You must be using the Ice element to use this ability.
    - This ability does not have a cooldown but a meter that charges up over time when not using the ability. Shares the same meter with Ice Stream Breath
- **🪨Earth🪨**
  - Earth shot
    - [Primary while NOT sneaking] Create a powerful shockwave that travels through blocks and liquids, damaging anyone in its path. Grants Earth Glow for a short time.
    - You must be using the Earth element to use this ability.
    - This attack has a 50% chance to inflict Weakness 1 on hit targets for 7 seconds.
  - Earth Pound
    - [Primary while sneaking and in air] Slam into the ground, creating a shockwave that damage anyone within a 6 block radius. Grants Earth Glow for a short time.
    - You must be using the Earth element to use this ability.
    - This attack has a 35% chance to inflict Weakness 1 on hit targets for 7 seconds.
  - Earth Flail
    - Toggle to create a flail of earth around you that damages and knocks back nearby entities. While active, you are unable to regenerate health, have slowness 6, and won't be able to jump or glideuntil you toggle the flail off. Grants the Earth Glow effect on hit targets.
    - You must be using the Earth element to use this ability. Switching elements also disables this power.
    - This attack has a 20% chance to inflict Weakness 1 on hit targets for 7 seconds.
</details>

## 🔶Passives🔶
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>
  
- 🐉Draconic Instincts🐉
  - Due to you being a dragon, you have the instincts of one. You can glide by holding jump and your scales give you natural armor and armor toughness.
- 🐲🟣Purple scales🐲🟣
  - You're the legendary purple dragon, why wouldn't you have purple scales? (your skin color is more purple than normal)
  
</details>

## ⛔Negatives⛔
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>
  
- 💤Overpowering Exhaustion💤
  - After using Aether, you are weak and unable to gain your full strength back for some while. You get slowness, weakness, and mining fatique for 1 minute and 30 seconds after transforming back to normal from Aether
- 🔥⚡🧊🪨Elemental Weakness🔥⚡🧊🪨
  - While you gain access to each element, you also gain access to each of their weaknesses while using their element. Fire cannot be used while in rain or water, Electricity also makes you take damage if you are too close to an entity while using its abilities, Ice grants increased fire damage taken, and Earth increases any Projectile damage taken.
- 👁️Overwhelming presence👁️
  - Purple Dragons are easier to detect due to their unique scale colors. As such, mobs detect can your presence further away than normal.
- 💢A Draconic Grudge💢
  - Due to dragons eating villager's animals for so long, villagers have learned to hate dragons slightly more than the average person, meaning you have higher prices
- 🔩Dragon Culture🔩
  - Dragons are known to not wear that much armor, especially the Purple Dragon. At most, you can only wear Helmets and Leggings
- 🏹Lackey🏹
  - Dragons never learned to use shields or any type of ranged weapons due to being naturally powerful
- 🍖Bigger Appetite🍖
  - A dragons appetite is always bigger than the average person. You exhaust quicker than the average person.
</details>
